notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 8th
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where the last used skin wouldn't save
- Added a startup logo while loading

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 7th
notes.content: - Fixed an issue where the game would stutter randomly

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 6th
notes.content:
Now you can use skins from your Steam inventory in game! Simply press the left or right arrow keys to cycle through all your skins.

Thank you for enjoying Lemon!

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 24
notes.content:
- Fixed an issue where clients would disconnect to the server at seemingly random
- Fixed other various issues

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 23
notes.content:
- Fixed various bugs
- Added a mute button

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
Added some new Lemon drops, two legendaries and a common.
- Million Dollar Lemon
- Lemoon
- Lime

Adjusted rarities for normal percentages, legendaries, epics and exotics are now slightly lower to obtain, thanks for everyone that participated so early.

notes.title: Update Notes For Jul 19th
notes.content: Fixed an issue where achievements wouldn't unlock if players had already surpassed the required score before the achievement was added.
